title: Aye farishto mujhe karbobala lechalo
body:
Ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi bhar tadapta raha ishq me
apne maula ka deedar kar na saka
chal rahi hai meri saase sue lahad
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
le chalo le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
mai dua hu lahad se utha le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Apne maula ke qadmo ko chumunga mai
farsh se arsh ko aaj chhu lunga mai
ye ibadat to hargiz na bhulunga mai, bhulunga mai
tumko allah ka wasta le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haq adaai hu mai tumko maloom hai
ek fidai hu mai tumko maloom hai
karbalai hu mai tumko maloom hai, maloom hai
meri mayyat yaha se utha le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ye lahad to nahi hai thikana mera
yani ab hai wahi aab o daana mera
ban gaya hai wahi ashiyana mera, ashiyana mera
ya najaf mujhko ya nainawa le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sar ke bal aaj chalta hua jaunga
hai irada yahi samarrah jaunga
mai khorasan najaf karbala jaunga, karbala jaunga
wo jaha hai mujhe us jagah le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Allah allah ghazi ka robo hasham
sina e aab par usne gaadha alam
socha sahil pe ye behre ehle haram, ehle haram
dosh par rakh ke ye alqama le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ae abad meri jannat hai karbobala
meri matti me hai ishq e aale eba
kuch nahi chahiye mujhko uske siwa, uske siwa
suwe daaman e ehle kisa le chalo
<<MINI>>
ae farishto mujhe karbala le chalo, le chalo le chalo
